About this item

  • Independent Integrated Spring Padding: GTPLAYER gaming chair is equipped with high-quality integrated spring padding that provides optimal comfort and support while gaming and working. This advanced seating technology provides dynamic support and adjusts to your position to ensure long-lasting comfort and reduce fatigue during long gaming sessions.
  • Soft, highly breathable fabric: Keeps you dry when sitting for long periods, reduces sweating and feeling hot, and provides a comfortable skin feel. High-quality fabric is also more durable and less prone to tears or wear that often occur with leather game chairs. The backrest design is complemented by precise and stylish embroidery that gives the chair an elegant and unique look.
  • Ergonomic design: The armrests are synchronously adjustable and adapt to the sitting position to promote an ergonomic posture and maximize comfort. With the adjustable backrest from 90 to 150 degrees and the fold-out footrest, you can customize your seating pleasure.
  • Quality without worries: The SGS certified level 3 gas lift cylinder allows for personal height adjustment, so you don't have to worry about the chair not fitting your height. The soft adjustable head and lumbar cushions provide additional support and improve comfort to reduce fatigue and enhance the gaming experience.
  • Satisfaction Guarantee: GTPLAYER dedicated customer service and quality guarantee offer you worry-free use. The computer gaming chair is easy to assemble with the included parts and tools.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I’m not sure what more you can ask for out of a chair at this price. Easy to assemble, looks pretty good, easy to operate, cushion, lumbar, and neck support are all really good and better than I was expecting. I love the foot rest and the ability to set the exact recline with ease. I’m 5’10” 170 lbs and this chair is very comfortable and foot rest is perfect. For larger people this chair may not be perfect, but it would likely get the job done. If you want something that looks fancy, this isn’t your chair. It looks nice and it’s sturdy, but not fancy. All parts are heavy black plastic. Are there better chairs out there. Yep. Do they cost 3x to 10x more? Yep. I’d say you get 90% of the chair for half the price of name brand “budget” gaming chair options. I’d be surprised if anyone who bought this chair didn’t rate it 8 out of 10 or higher.

  • Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Absolutely worth it! A great deal!
    Reviewed in the United States on November 12, 2025
    Color: Light Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This chair has been a fantastic purchase! I thought I would have to get a super expensive chair to get the comfort and support I wanted but this one was very reasonably priced and I got it on sale too. It's extremely versatile and very comfortable even for all day gaming. The lumbar pillow is the perfect firmness. The seat width is such a breath of fresh air. I can change how I'm sitting regularly and comfortably with plenty of room. All of its movement is smooth, i.e hinges, support column, wheels. My favourite feature so far is locking the recline in the exact angle I want with a quick push of a lever. It was easy to put together (though it took a bit of hand strength for some spots, like the last screws on the sides, so it may not be very easy for anyone with dexterity concerns.)

    It's almost completely noise-free and what noises it does make are quiet. The fabric is holding up well so far (2 months at the time of review). As a seamstress, I had concerns since the faux suede types usually aren't, but it's doing well. And the temperature regulates great. No overheating or sweating. The only thing struggling occasionally are the zippers on the neck and lumbar pillows. Sometimes they slip open since the fabric is so tight over the inserts, but they can be closed again and the zippers aren't technically broken yet. The footrest is a nice addition but doesn't extend far enough out to fully stretch my legs out. An extender that collapses into the main bars for the footrest would be needed since the bars are exactly the depth of the seat when put away. It they were longer they would stick out the back underneath the seat.

    All-in-all, a fantastic purchase that my weary body is appreciating when I'm at my computer. I'll try to remember to update this on the durability in a few months!

    1 out of 5 stars
    Bad, bad, and also not good.
    Reviewed in the United States on June 12, 2026
    Color: Red
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This chair looks great. I bought it because it had pocket spring construction and the seat wasn't your typical "chunk of foam on a piece of plywood"...and it was red. I hate it. It creaks and wobbles every time you move in it. It took me a solid hour to get one of the arm rest bolts threaded, then the next day, the arm fell off. It's back on, but I have no faith that it will not say goodbye again. The fabric is so slippery that after you sit in it for 15 or 20 minutes, you start to slide forward, out of the chair. Microfiber. Yuck. Warning: Do *not* try to lean back when the chair is in the upright position or you'll end up sitting on the floor (after the seat scrapes your back on the way down.) The headrest is in the right position and is quite comfortable. The lumbar cushion is uncomfortable and, if you do give it a try, it helps in pushing you out of the chair. Sitting on it doesn't help. If you decide to recline, make sure you have a friend there to take a video...so you can post it in the 'funny videos' area of YouTube. It reclines, but the spring isn't adjustable and has so little tension on it that you may end up somewhere you don't want to be. (e.g., the floor)

    I don't know who this chair was made for but it certainly wasn't me. Maybe it was you. I'm not a gamer. I just wanted a decent (and fairly comfortable) chair for my desk. Maybe if I was a 16 year old gamer I'd be ecstatic. But I'm not. While I'm at it, how does that tubby guy in the picture get his hugeness on that seat and cross his legs? I'm probably half his size and fairly flexible and I can't do that. I tried. Didn't work. I can easily get one leg up on the foot rest though - two if you cross them.

    Finally, on top of all of this, the pneumatic cylinder seems to lose air on a random basis.

    As much as I thought I would like this chair I do not. In fact, as much as I hate to say it, this is probably one of the worst chairs that has ever been introduced to my rear end...and back...and arms. I have been in old, wooden office chairs devoid of all padding and/or adjustment that were more comfortable.

    Even though it says "FREE RETURNS", I would return this chair in a heartbeat - except that I'd have to disassemble it and get it back in the box in a satisfactory manner. You should buy this chair, but only if you want a nice-looking, fabric covered chair that you will never enjoy sitting in. For me, it's just money wasted.

    Super gemütlich, allerdings muss man sich erst eine Woche an den Stuhl gewöhnen, um ihn gemütlich zu finden. Dies liegt an den Kissen. Am Anfang denk man „wie ungemütlich sind die Kissen“, aber der Körper muss sich erst eine Zeit an die neue Sitzhaltung gewöhnen und dann sagt man nur „BABA!“. Der Gaming Stuhl bietet ziemlich viele kleine Extras z.B. Die verstellbaren Lehnen oder auch die vordere Fußbank ,die man ausfahren kann.

    ZUSAMMENBAU:

    Bei mir hat das ganze fast eine Stunde gebraucht, dabei muss man beachten das ich davor noch nie irgendeinen Stuhl aufgebaut habe und erstmal einbisschen von der Anleitung geschockt war,allerdings stellte sich heraus das die Anleitung schnell zu kapieren ist. Man kann sie mit einen Ikea Aufbauplan vergleichen.

    FAZIT:

    Mein Fazit ist das ich diesen Stuhl auf jedenfall empfehlen kann, denn er bietet viele Extras ist gemütlich (wenn man sich an die Form eines Gaming Stuhls gewöhnt hat). Trotzdem ist er Preis von diesen Stuhl natürlich ein Batzen Geld, aber ich würde sagen es lohnt sich, denn diesen Stuhl behält man auf jedenfall einpaar Jahre und die Firma ist weltbekannt für ihre guten Gaming Stühle.

    Consegna effettuata prima del previsto. Il prodotto è arrivato in buono stato e ho preferito aspettare qualche giorno prima di esprimere un giudizio, ma dopo averla testata posso solo confermare la mia prima buona impressione. La poltrona è conforme alla descrizione e risponde in pieno alle mie aspettative. Molto comoda, bella, solida, regolabile in più parti, materiali di buona qualità. La misura dello schienale e del poggiapiedi per me vanno bene (sono alto 1.74). Ovviamente potrebbe non essere così per persone di statura maggiore, soprattutto per la lunghezza del poggiapiedi. Poi naturalmente c'è il valore aggiunto degli altoparlanti bluetooth, funzionano bene entrambe e hanno una discreta qualità audio. Nel montaggio ho avuto qualche piccolo contrattempo nel fissare alcune parti, più che altro perché l'ho montata da solo. Insomma direi che la cifra spesa per l'acquisto li vale tutti.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Calidad-precio insuperables
    Reviewed in Spain on April 3, 2020
    Color: Light Red
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Lo primero, un 10 a la entrega, me ha llegado 1 semana antes de lo inicialmente previsto.

    La calidad de los materiales es muy alta, destaca el tacto y la precisión de las piezas.

    El montaje es muy sencillo, siguiendo las instrucciones no cabe lugar a dudas (recomiendo un atornillador eléctrico para apretar los tornillos o es muy tedioso estar dándole vueltas a la llavecita).

    El funcionamiento, la comodidad, el que tenga de todo (bluetooth, altavoces, los reposabrazos ajustables (rotatoriamente también un poco) y el reposapiés la hace genial para sesiones intensas de ordenador, sea por trabajo, ocio o gaming. Incluso es cómoda para echar una siesta si se quiere.

    La única pega, y espero que el vendedor o fabricante me resuelva esta duda, es que el altavoz izquierdo no suena. Entiendo que estos altavoces son para una experiencia envolvente y por ende no tienen mucho volumen, ya que se escucha muy tenuemente. Pero el altavoz izquierdo no me suena. Mirando el receptor bluetooth, parece que cada altavoz debería tener un cable jack independiente, y conectar ambos cables al receptor. Yo sólo encontre uno, y antes de abrir la funda (que implica desmontarlo) quiero asegurarme de que sí que tiene que haber un cable, y que éste se encontrará dentro de la funda por haberse colado por el agujero de salida.

    Sin duda, al precio que está, la recomiendo encarecidamente.

About this Item

  • Independent Integrated Spring Padding: GTPLAYER gaming chair is equipped with high-quality integrated spring padding that provides optimal comfort and support while gaming and working. This advanced seating technology provides dynamic support and adjusts to your position to ensure long-lasting comfort and reduce fatigue during long gaming sessions.
  • Soft, highly breathable fabric: Keeps you dry when sitting for long periods, reduces sweating and feeling hot, and provides a comfortable skin feel. High-quality fabric is also more durable and less prone to tears or wear that often occur with leather game chairs. The backrest design is complemented by precise and stylish embroidery that gives the chair an elegant and unique look.
  • Ergonomic design: The armrests are synchronously adjustable and adapt to the sitting position to promote an ergonomic posture and maximize comfort. With the adjustable backrest from 90 to 150 degrees and the fold-out footrest, you can customize your seating pleasure.
  • Quality without worries: The SGS certified level 3 gas lift cylinder allows for personal height adjustment, so you don't have to worry about the chair not fitting your height. The soft adjustable head and lumbar cushions provide additional support and improve comfort to reduce fatigue and enhance the gaming experience.
  • Satisfaction Guarantee: GTPLAYER dedicated customer service and quality guarantee offer you worry-free use. The computer gaming chair is easy to assemble with the included parts and tools.
